messages:
maria (docs): Quick sync: planning v1 -> v2 migration. Proposal: 14d soft deprecate (warnings), then 7d enforcement. Need docs, SDK, examples coordinated. Opening deprecation banner PR tonight.

sam (sdk): Ack. Main SDK changes: rename 'model' -> 'model_id', embedding dims may differ, and streaming tweak. We'll ship a compat shim + migration example. I'll open SDK PR with tests.

june (devex): Owners: @sam (sdk), @maria (docs), @leo (oncall). I'll add a short troubleshooting table and canonical smoke curl. Anyone can run `rg "/v1/invoke" docs/ examples/` to find snippets.

leo (eng-oncall): I'll prepare canary and rollback steps. Ops command for docs/ops: `./ops/route-switch --to v1-proxy --reason "rollback: migration"`. Canary baseline: watch for >0.5% error delta.

docs-lint-bot: Reminder: docs PRs must pass link-checker and code-block-lint before merge.

maria (docs): Action recap: sam -> SDK PR + compat tests; june -> smoke script + troubleshooting; leo -> rollback playbook + canary; I'll add migration quickstart and 'what breaks' bullets. Target: soft-deprec announcement tomorrow EOD.
